description: Sources of UI kits and templates, fonts, icons, illustrations, colors, backgrounds, mockups, logos, placeholders, stock photos, video, music, voiceover and 3D for apps, websites and games: price, whether the license allows commercial use, needs credit, can ship inside an app or be fetched by bots, the rules to follow and how an agent connects (MCP, API, package, download). get_asset gives the full card with the license quotes.

category.description: Optional category, e.g. ui-kits, fonts, icons, illustrations, 3d-illustrations, color-palettes, backgrounds-patterns, mockups, logos, placeholders, favicons-og, stock-photos, music, voiceover, 3d-models

free_commercial_only.description: Only sources whose free plan allows commercial use

query.description: Optional words to match in the name or description

redistribute_ok.description: Only sources whose terms let you pass the files (or a generator's outputs) on to your own users, e.g. from your own generator or template tool (yes or with conditions; checked source by source, others are not checked yet)

style.description: Optional look, e.g. minimal, flat, outline, hand-drawn, 3d, isometric, playful, corporate, colorful, pixel

name: find_assets
title: Content assets and licenses
